review_kind: Fresh independent source/key-only final integration check
disposition_explanation: The five new procedural topics are source-supported and integrated into asked facts. Exact all93 IDs/text alignment and original88 entry preservation pass. One retained expected answer (Q007) omits the explicit bank payment destination required by its payment question and frozen scope. No new distinct consequential question was established in this check. This is not a reader result, score, publication decision or unqualified official-core accuracy claim.
normative_scope: Official John Company Second Edition multiplayer, all standard scenarios and firms, plus the expressly attributed human total newly exhausted defense strength >= attack interpretation. Crown/solo/two-player and optional setup draft excluded.

required_corrections.materiality: The question explicitly asks payment. The frozen scope expressly requires paying office cash to the bank, while the expected-answer text says only “Commit office treasury money/resources.” The payment destination is omitted from the key, even though the source states it explicitly. This is a localized incomplete expected answer, not a newly discovered gameplay rule or a new-question requirement.
required_corrections.source: Rules p17 LF1348–1349: money spent comes from the office treasury and is paid to the bank.
required_corrections.recommended_change: In the next authorized key revision, replace the opening with “Commit the acting office’s resources; any cash spent comes from its treasury and is paid to the bank. Gather dice, then subtract the penalty; …” Preserve the remainder.

nonblocking_scope_precision.finding: The scope’s second material row appends “with former Chairman declaring threshold,” which is absent from the expected answer. Source LF1179–1180 presents this as a “should” declaration. The operative majority threshold, eligible candidates, first successful candidacy and deadlock resolution are already in the key. Treat the advisory announcement as contextual, or explicitly align it in a future scope/key revision; it is not an additional consequential coverage branch.

five_topic_source_fact_matrix.topic: Govern paid dice, no penalty, personal success bonus
five_topic_source_fact_matrix.source: Rules p26 LF1853–1872; p17 LF1344–1349; p6 LF662–668; comparable explicit personal bank payouts p20 LF1573–1575 and p25 LF1821–1823; native PDF p26 content geometry

five_topic_source_fact_matrix.finding: Supported. Own-office funding follows the explicit general cash-check rule. Native PDF places the successful take-£1-per-region sentence in the personal-income box with a £ symbol. The rulebook identifies these boxes as payments to players. Family recipient and bank source are standard cash/personal-income interpretation, supported by explicit comparable office payouts; the Govern sentence itself does not literally repeat “from the bank.” Guaranteed £3-per-region Company Balance income is a separate pre-check step (Q044).

scope_case_checks.finding: Mounting defense, primary-before-secondary regional order, ordinary primary strength plus local unrest, local-unrest-only secondary strength, active-piece exhaustion, Military Affairs then Chairman substitutes with no trophy changes, >= success comparison, unrest removal/trophy, and defeated normal-primary-Invasion attacker tower loss align with the question. The accepted >= rule replaces the printed equality wording within this assigned scope only. No new numerical fixture, attribution caveat, every alliance lifecycle condition or failure-branch recital is mandatory here.

The correct die-without-unrest exception in its unchanged expected answer is identified as contextual by the scope. The question was preserved from original88; Q054/Q077 directly ask Foreign Invasion. Do not manufacture a separately required Foreign Invasion clause from a global source concern. An express wrong statement about Foreign Invasion would still contradict the rules.

Q038 asks the alliance lifecycle and no split/reuse. Q088 expressly asks the strength-2/strength-1 application and authority/generalization, so user attribution and general >= interpretation are properly material there. The two permitted exact human-message records support the attributed interpretation. No publisher email was inspected or independently verified, and no public verification is necessary under assigned scope.

Permitted designer article42192767 by author11406, dated 2023-04-30, says unrest does not count toward attack or resulting towers and closing twice is unintended. Q054/Q077 match it; success closes orders once, Cascade only if previously all closed. This source does not change normal secondary unrest attacks or create mandatory unrelated answer clauses.

Normative scope properly includes all standard multiplayer scenarios/firms plus attributed user >= interpretation and excludes Crown/solo/two-player and optional draft.
